body:
One installed-evidence lookup completed: UNAVAILABLE IMPLEMENTATION EVIDENCE; first-layer signed side/order remains UNRESOLVED. Owned note unpublished-local-ref:8b873803bfec9db7, SHA256 20194964ab255229ddbc0113ffca5044ed6de1b2a25d4110fa2d794c020fa7e7, contains exact package/binary/manual hashes, full package inventory, line/page evidence and requested physical-z mapping.

Measured ref-ab3b45338c202f661802 SHA256564ed098356c46f68120e2d6cc2a97c686b4d16ec31f3ef55b3182749ec60c3d belongs to calculix-ccx2.21-1build1 amd64. Its installed inventory contains only the binary, changelog, copyright and man page; no implementation source. calculix-ccx-doc is not installed. Zero implementation files were opened (limit3). The2.22 test package was not treated as2.21 evidence.

Retained2.21 manual section5.15 printedp74/text3208-3219,3233-3249 gives a worked composite example listed from beam top downward and says the shell normal/node order controls that direction. It does not explicitly tie the first layer to a positive/negative normal face for our outward normal. Section6.2.14 p110 fixes local z=normal and node order; section7.117 pp582-583 establishes OFFSET0=midsurface,+0.5=top and-0.5=bottom. This supplies documentary offset endpoints but no source-verified first-layer index or expanded coordinate/material map.

Requested geometry remains R48,zoutward+,h0.225in, envelope midsurface z=-0.0625in, o=5/18. Under the declared positive-top coordinate convention, z=s-o*h yields bounds[-0.175,0.05]in; desired rib/lower-skin/upper-skin intervals remain[-0.175,-0.05],[-0.05,0],[0,0.05]in and radii[47.825,47.95],[47.95,48],[48,48.05]in. Native row placement is explicitly unresolved, so no ready/executed deck is claimed.

Precise missing evidence is an already-installed2.21 build-associated layer-index/material assignment and signed offset/expansion implementation, or an unambiguous signed-face documentary statement. Package-source absence is bounded to the permitted inventory, not a whole-machine claim. No download/install/build/solver/tests/patch/alternate construction, parameter change or broad search. Local ABD acceptance stands; physical/source/stability gaps remain, comparator990000 and diagnostics unfitted. This closes only the bounded lookup. Original sphere has now landed at primarymain19533a82d619a4af9c13b99f9fe46944f5249281 including d7b704f5; existing cylinder/Akhmeteli handoff duties remain independent.

links.what: Completed one read-only installed-package/manual lookup and returned exact unavailable implementation evidence, documented offset/normal statements and conditional requested-z mapping; no physical or benchmark closure.
